title: Drive a registered recipe to completion as a durable generator
narrative: Long-running judgment-bearing work is started as a durable generator over a registered recipe. When no external guidance is required, the first start call returns completion — the driver does not invent a second harness or free-form graph. Complements offline recipe evolution (`taloneth_insp_recipe_evolution_loop`) which chooses which recipe is active. Tracks R-IOC-GENERATOR[^insp-ioc-01].
implementation: `DurableGraphGenerator.start` / `list_recipes` resolve `GraphTemplateRegistry` catalog ids and persist via `GeneratorRunStore`. Host entry: `host_kit.host_durable_graph_generator` / `durable_generator_host`. Node component kind `guidance_request` is reserved for guidance soft points; this story exercises zero-advice completion.
validation: Harness `durable_generator` via `scenario.yaml`. Hard expects completed kind, sequence 1, recipe listed, zero guidance yields. Unit tests: `tests/test_durable_graph_generator.py`.
